index.title: Dune Apps — iPhone tools that keep your data on your phone
index.description: Small, careful iPhone tools that run entirely on your device — no servers, no accounts, nothing collected. Receipt Snap and DriveSnap, plus essays on building private software.

drivesnap.title: DriveSnap — a mileage log that never leaves your phone
drivesnap.description: DriveSnap records business drives automatically and keeps every one on your iPhone. No account, no servers, no drive caps. Free during launch, including the CSV export and tax report.
